message.content: {"rules":["An Allocator implementation must handle zero-sized allocations even if its underlying allocator does not support them or returns a null pointer for them.","Moving an allocator whose allocations reside in its own storage, such as MyAlloc([u8; N]), must not leave pointers to allocated memory unadjusted.","Memory blocks currently allocated by an Allocator must point to valid memory and remain valid until the block is deallocated or the allocator is dropped. A block is currently allocated if its starting address was returned by allocate, grow, or shrink and it has not subsequently been deallocated. A call to deallocate or a successful grow or shrink deallocates the block; grow or shrink returning Err does not.","Copying, cloning, or moving an Allocator must not invalidate memory blocks returned from it.","A copied or cloned Allocator must behave like the original allocator.","A memory block currently allocated by an Allocator may be passed to any method of that allocator that accepts such an argument. A block is currently allocated if its starting address was returned by allocate, grow, or shrink and it has not subsequently been deallocated. A call to deallocate or a successful grow or shrink deallocates the block; grow or shrink returning Err does not."]}
